# Example

## Modality.json

Here are additional examples of `modality.json` for different lerobot dataset dataset. Copy the relevant `modality.json` into the dataset `<DATASET_PATH>/meta/modality.json`

`eval_gr00t_so100.py` provides an example of how to run the policy generated by the fine-tuning model.
